text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I am the king. As a first-rate Umamusume, I shall show the world precisely what makes a king a king.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: As such, I bestow upon you the right to support me! Now, first-rate trainer of mine, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
